name: Shojo-tan: Dai 2-maku Goshujin-sama ni Shojo o Sasageru Genki na Maid Hen
original_name: しょじょたん 第2幕 ご主人様に処女を捧げる元気なメイド編
source:
Twin sister of senior maid gets scolded often and looks up to her sister. She gives all her energy to master, and the day of ritual to establish master-slave relations comes for her as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
高级女仆的双胞胎妹妹经常被责骂，很尊敬她的妹妹。她把所有的精力都奉献给了主人，建立主奴关系的仪式的日子也来到了她的身边。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-march-2008-12riven-climinal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
